<div class="card-body">
'''Devastator''' is a [[Dark]] [[Starship]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">デバステーター</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">パイロットを６名、乗客を８名、ビークルを２台、タイ・ファイターを４機、乗せられる。ドッキング能力を持つ。能力値２の専属パイロットを持つ。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-301o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ラルティアの制圧に派遣された。ダース・ベイダーの指揮下で、反逆者レイア・オーガナ姫の乗る外交艇タンティヴィＩＶを追跡し、捕獲した。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Devastator.

'''Card text:''' May carry six pilots, eight passengers, two vehicles, and four TIE fighters. Has docking capability and a permanent pilot with ability 2.

'''Lore:''' Sent to subdue Ralltiir. Under Darth Vader's command it pursued and captured the diplomatic vessel Tantive IV carrying the rebel Princess Leia Organa.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Devastator]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
